Nina (Finance): Heads up: Lumen Bridge (acct LB-302) invoice INV-2025-4419 for $62,300 is 21 days overdue. Customer requested a 3-month split. Card on file failed on retry.
Sam (AM): They're an enterprise pilot, usage steady. Customer emailed saying: "We can do staggered payments if you accept ACH or split on card. Will sign agreement today."
Tariq (Payments): Retry returned DECLINE_CARD_EXPIRED at 2024-05-10T14:22Z, attempt_id=pay_9b2c1. Recommend ask for new card or ACH.
customer-bot: Received customer note: will provide ACH details by tomorrow and sign terms.
Maya (Collections): Policy: invoices >$50k require 30% upfront. We can do 30/35/35 with signed agreement and ACH token/card on file. If customer insists on 25% need manager sign-off.
Nina (Finance): Let's require 30% today. Sam, get the ACH details + signed agreement. Tariq, hold retries until they provide details.
Sam (AM): Reached out, sent DocuSign and ACH form. Customer confirmed will initiate ACH today.
Tariq (Payments): I'll accept ACH push once we have routing + account name; will run micro-deposits if needed. I'll also flag the account to suppress dunning while plan pending.
Maya (Collections): Opening collection case COL-4502, reminder 10 days after agreement for first payment. If not received escalate to legal.
Sam (AM): Customer replied: "ACH initiated. Expect transfer within 48 hrs. Signed agreement attached."
Tariq (Payments): ACH received and cleared. Posting payment of $18,690 (30%) txn=ach_5c3d. Invoice status updated to partial paid; scheduling remainder at 30d and 60d.
Nina (Finance): Thanks. Updated SF with agreement, flagged billing. Closing unless further issues.
